layout.text: 张扬而富有叛逆感，情绪表达鲜明，喜欢以轻松和玩味面对环境。年轻气质之下有很强的适应力，也不愿被既定身份束缚。
沉默、克制、自律，很少将个人情绪置于任务之前。长期责任塑造了他的稳定与可靠，对同伴的重视通常通过行动而非语言表达。
优雅、沉着，有强烈的责任意识和原则感。长期处于权力与家族关系之中，使她习惯控制情绪，也格外重视尊严、忠诚与自己的判断。
1975；以 Magik 身份于 1983 完整确立 / Marvel Characters, Inc. / Marvel Entertainment
疏离、锋利，情绪很少完全暴露，言行中常带着讥诮与反叛。经历使她对亲近关系保持戒备，也形成了很强的个人边界。
随性、爱开玩笑，对危险有一种近乎游戏化的态度。好奇心很强，不喜欢循规蹈矩，轻松的外表下始终保留鲜明的自主意识。
寡言、克制，习惯以纪律和任务要求约束自己的情绪。表面保持距离，实际具有细腻而复杂的情感，对责任与羁绊有很深的执着。
活泼、真诚，对未知事物保持明显的好奇心。她比身边的人更容易表达情绪，也有很强的伙伴意识，在紧张环境中仍保留温暖和乐观。
Iron Man — 钢铁侠 / Tony Stark
聪明、锋芒外露，习惯用幽默和戏谑掩饰压力。强烈的个人主义与责任感长期并存，使他既具有表演欲，也不断反思自己的选择。
沉默、精准，几乎没有外露的情绪。举止具有舞蹈般的秩序感，却始终伴随明显的压迫感，以高度同步和绝对服从形成独特的双生关系。
寡言、独立，长期习惯单独行动，对自身经历几乎从不解释。加入团队后逐渐建立信任，其人物核心更多体现在责任、坚持与牺牲。
Michael Myers — 迈克尔·迈尔斯
1978 / Compass International Pictures / Trancas International Films
沉默、执拗，几乎不显露正常的情绪与动机。他的存在感来自持续、缓慢而不可动摇的行动方式，使人物始终保持难以理解的恐惧感。
乐观、热情，对人与世界保持近乎天真的好奇。非常渴望建立联系和找到自身归属，即使身处危险环境，也很少失去友善与积极态度。

releaseAttempts.reason: Native WebView painted an opaque white iframe canvas because child and host color schemes differed. CSS transparency and functional checks alone were insufficient; visual verification rejected delivery.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold launch restored Home, Task, Gallery and Settings; screenshots and runtime check passed, zero exceptions. Native isolated canvas probe confirmed syncing child colorScheme to host removes the white backing.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native dual-video and compositing passed, but rail return-position assertion failed after wheel input. One-shot restoration could be overwritten during the return transition; revised to hold saved position through the transition and prevent room wheel default/focus scrolling.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold start and all core surfaces passed; new errors0. Rollback recorded in7a8c747; corrected sourcebb5a09b deployed only after focused checks and a new production build.

releaseAttempts.reason: Computed-style review found inherited iframe focus rules overriding the transparent controls in light appearance. Candidate was held while the user remained on verified A8E250 release. Specificity corrected in721610d and explicitly checked before final build/deployment.

Candidate passed timeline interactions but emitted an unlisted external-video CSP diagnostic. Paired desktop and sidecar were restored for direct old-version comparison. The exact same 01CbIdBLVCiUlQLMC8Ct3vq014VS02lwCaq/high.mp4 media-src violation was reproduced on the old executable; diagnostic is inherited, not introduced by timeline. Production source and security policy unchanged.
releaseAttempts.comparisonConclusion: Exact diagnostic inherited; old core navigation passed with no new errors or HTTP failures. Restoration recorded in ac91d33. Same unchanged candidate redeployed at 17:19:44 and final native checks passed.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native visual review rejected the UV diagnostic texture in place of the Microsoft mark. Initial HTML Image.decode checks had passed, unlike the worker texture path. Subsequent worker pixel checks proved Thread.absolutePath prefixes the Gallery base even for root-relative URLs. Fixed with a base-relative packaged RGBA PNG, without changing runtime code or shaders.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold launch restored the matched baseline. Home model, Task, Gallery, Market/Ledger, Settings and Account passed in both appearances, background playback and explicit return passed, zero new diagnostics. Evidence: output/playwright/identity-rollback-native-report.json.

releaseAttempts.reason: Both native themes and all activation interactions passed. Two unlisted diagnostics at the final console gate ([nuxt] manifest fetch and _this.initSync) require baseline attribution before delivery.
releaseAttempts.comparisonConclusion: Direct paired old-executable test reproduced the exact _this.initSync diagnostic. A separate bounded old-version reload comparison did not reproduce the Nuxt manifest diagnostic; it remains a strict failure in the final candidate test, not allow-listed. Same unchanged candidate redeployed at 2026-09-09T01:59:52.2519714+08:00. Final native interaction checks passed in both themes. Two additional remote-thumbnail CSP messages were attributed using identical legacy portfolio-tree and security-policy Git object hashes and existing packaged fallback textures; raw reports retained. Qualification evidence: output/playwright/activation-native-qualified-report.json.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native cold launch, video, new dimensions and label passed; pointer hold was not charging after 650ms. Restored matching previous pair before diagnosis.
releaseAttempts.finalOutcome: Same unchanged candidate redeployed; explicit bringToFront before input and event capture; both native themes and all interaction checks passed. First failure cause not conclusively established; raw failure retained. No production activation logic or security policy changes.

releaseAttempts.reason: Both native appearance and interaction flows passed, but the second card retained a remote poster URL blocked by img-src. Native video also used the inherited remote URL. Restore the previous pair while binding the changed card to existing packaged video and cover.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Restored canonical shortcut Home, Task, Gallery and Settings passed without page errors. Screenshots: output/playwright/zima-rollback-{task,gallery,settings}.png; report: output/playwright/zima-rollback-report.json.
releaseAttempts.finalOutcome: Previous pair restored and verified, second-card original media bundled, corrected release rebuilt and redeployed. Final native checks passed in both appearances with zero new diagnostics.

releaseAttempts.reason: Both native themes, ten models and core interactions passed; previously unlisted CSP diagnostics for existing remote Gallery posters and Market thumbnails require baseline attribution. Restore verified pair before comparison. User requested unchanged card media.
releaseAttempts.comparisonConclusion: Eight Gallery poster diagnostics reproduced on paired old executable. Four portfolio thumbnail diagnostics separately attributed by identical emitting tree, CSP and packed fallback textures; not claimed as runtime-reproduced. Same candidate redeployed without source changes.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native model and lighting are visible, but returning from Home to the same equipped Gallery character leaves load-state stuck loading. Restore verified pair before fixing the state race.
releaseAttempts.resolution: Replaced prop-driven loading resets with last-rendered identity and ignored stale callbacks; keep adapter stable when callbacks change. Prior-source regression reproduces the readiness failure. Both preview appearances and corrected native release passed.

releaseAttempts.reason: Legacy WorkItem deferred click invoked after destruction; native flow passed but console verification rejected this release.

temporaryRollback.Reason: Unchanged Gallery runtime emitted _this.initSync after rapid core navigation. Restore baseline to compare before classifying the diagnostic.

releaseAttempts.conclusion: The same _this.initSync error occurs on the previous verified executable under identical navigation. Unchanged Gallery runtime; the Account cleanup does not introduce it.

rollbackHistory.reason: Native minimize verification: WebView2 leaves document.hidden false, so the browser-only visibility gate did not suspend rendering. Restored verified pair while adding an explicit native-window activity signal.
